facts.business: Cohance Lifesciences is a science-led contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) providing integrated services from molecular design through clinical and commercial supply, with specialized platforms for complex modalities like antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs).

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Title deeds of certain immovable properties (land and buildings) obtained from erstwhile merged companies are not yet registered in the company's name; lease agreements for certain right-of-use assets from erstwhile merged companies are not yet executed in the company's name.

key_risks: Regulatory challenges across parts of the business
Operational challenges across parts of the business
Integration of distinct scientific legacies and new therapeutic-modality platforms
Technology transfer risks and knowledge discontinuity in outsourcing model
facts.related_party_note: Properties (land and buildings) with gross carrying value of Rs 12.57 crore and Rs 0.90 crore respectively are held in names of erstwhile companies (Suven Lifesciences Limited, Suven Synthesis Limited, Suven Nishtaa Pharma Private Limited, Inventis Drug Delivery Systems Limited, RA Chem Pharma Limited, AVRA Laboratories Private Limited) that have merged with the company; lease arrangements for right-of-use assets (land Rs 17.27 crore, building Rs 1.72 crore) from erstwhile merged companies (GMR Aerospace and Industrial Park, CDC Industrial Infra Limited) are pending execution in company's name.
